sourceRevisionPolicy: Use the clean Git HEAD containing this protocol; every report records that commit SHA.
revisionNote: v2 expands the known-thread corpus from ten to fourteen fixtures (locked, high-volume, negative-counter-delta, and exhausted-tree shapes) and records the reported-comment counter delta in every normalized observation. v1 reports remain comparable through their recorded fixture hashes.

discoveryGate.candidateRequirement: Every emitted candidate is a canonical Reddit thread URL.
discoveryGate.failureRequirement: Empty, blocked, parse, and transport outcomes remain explicit.

threadGate.expectedNonSuccessNote: t01 is the retained block-regression fixture from v1. t11 is intentionally beyond the fetch limit, and t12/t13 sit at the near-complete boundary with heavy deleted-comment trees; they stress honest incompleteness classification rather than success.
